title: DownSquad: Music Discs
description: Tracks on the DownSquad server for events that are popular in Russia
body: Dear players! We are the DownSquad server, and this resource pack is for you! This resource pack changes the music in the records! Download it to listen to popular songs from Russia in the game! We will be glad to support you, and also if you buy a pass to the DownSquad server!![DS3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd6712aff75b515b164e8ea9bb315a4cdee6cc94_0.webp)
